sourceDefinitions.purpose: Question definitions and allowed answer domains only; respondent rows are not copied.

limits: All identities, combinations of answers, workflow events, recommendations and model assessments are fictional.
Scenario balance is designed for UI coverage, not population statistics or model training.
Historical answers do not establish current circumstances.
ERA aggregates and SGSC households have not been joined to these fictional people.

Gender, preferred name, addresses, phone numbers and emails are invented. Gender is assigned independently of the name. Phone numbers come from ranges reserved for fiction and emails use example.com, so none can reach a real person. Street names are invented and are not real addresses.

circumstanceDefinitions.label: Difficulty paying energy bills
circumstanceDefinitions.illustrativeRule: Q32_1 is Quite difficult or Very difficult

circumstanceDefinitions.label: Reported inability to pay on time
Reported financial strain
circumstanceDefinitions.illustrativeRule: Z8a reports some or a lot of difficulty

evidenceFieldDefinitions.label: Difficulty paying the electricity bill
Kept the home comfortably warm in cold weather
Kept the home comfortably cool in hot weather
Avoided heating or cooling to save money
Applied for government assistance with energy bills
Contacted the provider about difficulty paying bills
Unable to pay an energy bill on time due to financial difficulty
Unable to afford other essential expenses
Reported a bill extension
Reported a reduction in the amount owing
Reported a repayment plan
Reported hardship-program enrolment
Reported advice on reducing energy costs
Reported help moving to a cheaper energy plan
Reported a concession/rebate eligibility check
Reported appliance-replacement support
Currently enrolled in a hardship program when reported
Reported life-support registration
Health condition or disability affects energy use
Reported an energy-bill concession
Self-described financial situation
allowedValues: Doing OK and making ends meet
Having some difficulty but just making ends meet
Having a lot of difficulty paying bills and covering basic living expenses

recommendationDefinitions.label: Review payment options
recommendationDefinitions.description: Discuss payment options that fit the person’s current circumstances.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Discuss an affordable repayment plan
recommendationDefinitions.description: Review a repayment plan with the person and the provider.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Review a bill extension
recommendationDefinitions.description: Check whether an extension is available and suitable.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Assess hardship assistance
recommendationDefinitions.description: Review current support needs and available hardship assistance.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Check concessions or rebates
recommendationDefinitions.description: Check eligibility rather than assuming entitlement.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Review energy costs and available plans
recommendationDefinitions.description: Review costs and available tariffs or plans within the person’s actual provider choices.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Review home-efficiency support
recommendationDefinitions.description: Discuss options that could help maintain a comfortable home.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Review appliance-support options
recommendationDefinitions.description: Check whether suitable appliance support is available.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Arrange a specialist worker review
recommendationDefinitions.description: Arrange an appropriate worker review of the reported energy needs.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Confirm relevant account information
recommendationDefinitions.description: Confirm relevant details with the person and provider.

recommendationDefinitions.label: Review other suitable assistance
recommendationDefinitions.description: Discuss other available support appropriate to the person’s situation.
